changes.change: Hosting modules, taken by tag as github.com/schryer/pubkit//terraform/<name>?ref=vX.Y.Z. terraform/hosting reads the hosting block of pubkit.json and writes every zone in it: its DNS at Hetzner, Cloudflare or both (multi-provider, with both providers' nameservers in the apex NS rrset, through terraform/dns-zone), its email records from its mail provider, and its sites: server addresses, Cloudflare Pages projects (served from Pages or a standby server) and Cloud Run sites' records, whose domain mappings terraform/cloud-run-sites makes, apart so a repository without Google Cloud needs no Google credentials

A hosting block in pubkit.json holds every provider-specific fact the hosting modules use: providers, each named by the repository with a type pubkit supports (hetzner, cloudflare, google-cloud, mailbox-org) and its own settings, and zones, each naming the providers of its DNS, email and sites. pubkit sync and sync --check stop on a setting the block's types do not know, since Terraform would ignore it

actions/deploy-static, a composite action that deploys a directory to a server over rsync (with a pinned host key, or one scanned each run) and to Cloudflare Pages through a pinned wrangler, or to both, and fails rather than deploy nowhere or to half a target
deploy-static's scripts use [[ ]] for their tests, as SonarQube Cloud asks (shelldre:S7688)
